name: graft-robotics
description: Pair Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Apple Silicon MLX, or local Gemma 4 safely with physical robots via a deterministic ROS 2 pre-flight boundary and ISO 10218:2025 / EU 2023/1230 compliance engine. Includes 19 MCP tools, 7 playbooks (incl. /ros2-compliance-audit), 4 form elicitations, 5 live resources, PreToolUse safety hooks, the Graft Workbench MCP App, 6-family Hand HAL, and Rust graft-core LAN LiDAR meshing.
